sources.title: README
sources.locator: intro; Two session types; Working with agents; Install; Private remote access; Where things run
sources.finding: Free open-source ADE for Windows/macOS/Linux; browser UI; Terminal and Agent Controller sessions; installers; tlbx Link (dev channel); sessions keep running when the browser closes while the host stays awake; AGPL-3.0 with commercial licensing.

sources.title: FEATURES.md
sources.locator: sections: Agent work from any browser; Two session surfaces; Agent-visible control plane; Files, Git; Mobile; Remote access
sources.finding: Current product boundary: real PTYs, Agent Controller sessions for Codex app-server and ACP agents, control plane work items, Git read views, Dev Browser, several browsers on one host, passwords and share grants; not a VPN or hosted relay.

sources.title: ARCHITECTURE.md
sources.locator: Runtime model; Command Bay; Agent control plane; Security; Install and update pipeline
sources.finding: mt, mthost (PTYs) and mtagenthost (structured agents); persistent backend-owned queues; control plane records; PBKDF2 auth, keychain/DPAPI secrets, share grants; update service checks GitHub releases.

sources.title: TLBX-MCP.md
sources.locator: Transports; Terminal TUI configuration; Tools; Short calls and parallel workflows
sources.finding: Native MCP server at POST /api/mcp and `mt mcp --stdio`; per-thread credentials; tools for sessions, queues, work items, dispatch, structured agents, repos, boards, browser; workflow_run chains up to 64 calls.

sources.title: OpenAPI document
sources.finding: REST surface for sessions, input, buffers, notes, files, share grants, API keys, updates, web preview and browser control.

sources.title: English UI strings
sources.finding: UI offers session cost, Allow/approval for agent requests, Spaces with worktree creation, Git commit/merge/abort-merge flows.

sources.title: Space service
sources.finding: Spaces create Git worktrees for the sidebar via `git worktree add`.

sources.title: Board models
sources.finding: Freeform boards of notes, to-do entries, URLs and launches with revisions; items can launch sessions with a prompt and working directory.

sources.title: Share access modes
sources.finding: Share grants are ViewOnly or FullControl and expire.

sources.title: Mobile app store handoff
sources.finding: ai.tlbx.app is a connection manager for multiple tlbx instances (WebView), iOS/iPadOS 16 and Android 8 minimum, collects no analytics.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.finding: Private vulnerability reporting; 3 business-day acknowledgement target.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.finding: GNU Affero General Public License version 3; no project-specific or-later grant stated.

sources.title: Mobile device bridge privacy
sources.finding: Optional local Chrome Mobile Device Bridge; privacy notes for device emulation.

sources.title: README screenshot opencode-session.webp
sources.finding: Real tlbx window: nine sidebar sessions (Codex, Claude, OpenCode, pulse dev server, tests), OpenCode transcript adding GET /api/status and tests, session cost counter.

sources.title: Bounded search: SSO and orgs
sources.finding: Matches are GitHub OIDC for the build server and a trust helper; no SSO, organization or role model in the product (single installation password, API keys, share grants).

sources.title: Bounded search: webhooks and event triggers
sources.finding: Only generated API typings and a package-lock mention; no webhook endpoints.

sources.title: Bounded search: managed cloud, containers
sources.finding: No vendor cloud runtime or container isolation; hits are test fakes and a proxy header.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry SDKs
sources.locator: grep posthog|sentry|appinsights|analytics over src/ and docs/
sources.finding: No analytics SDK found; mobile app store notes say no analytics; update service queries GitHub releases.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules
sources.locator: grep -w cron over src/ and docs/; FEATURES.md follow-ups
sources.finding: No cron or recurring scheduler matches; FEATURES.md documents immediate or scheduled follow-ups queued per session (backend-owned Command Bay queue); DelayedActionScheduler is a generic in-process timer helper.

sources.title: Bounded search: specs and memory
sources.locator: grep spec-driven|living spec over src/ and docs/
sources.finding: No requirements/spec store; boards and notes are free-form.

sources.title: Release v11.1.8 assets
sources.locator: release asset list (checked through the GitHub releases API)
sources.finding: The stable release attaches host tarballs (mt-linux-x64, mt-linux-arm64, mt-osx-arm64) and SBOMs only; no APK, AAB or IPA is attached. The README and features document do not mention the native mobile app.

sources.title: Update service
sources.finding: The host starts an update check timer 10 seconds after launch and repeats it every 30 minutes (7 minutes in developer mode). Settings expose only an update channel and whether the sidebar shows the update notification; no setting disables the check.
